verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows LM Studio letting users version, review, or roll back automations. The nearest items are adjacent: Bionic auto-saves document edits, regenerate keeps earlier message generations, and the app lets you manage prompts and configurations. None of these is versioning or rollback of automations, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
